item.text: {"search_note":"I found no 2024 evidence of Indian-backed proxies, clients, militias, or arms recipients committing atrocities with Modi’s acceptance or direction. I found no 2024 case where Modi publicly accepted responsibility for foreseeable proxy conduct, because there is no clear proxy structure in the evidence set.
